name: Half-dial menu
description: A closing section as tall as its content, about 480px at 1440, on the surface tone as its own ground. In the lower centre sits a half-ellipse menu 800px wide by 400px high: five page links, each a name in the display face at the sub step, lie on an ellipse (rx 330, ry 200) around a pivot at the bottom centre. They are the site's other pages where it has them, and on a one-page site its own sections and the contact; never a dead link. The active name is in full ink and the rest in the muted ink. Hover, focus or the arrow keys turn the arc so the chosen name travels to the top (500ms ease); a click follows the link. No hands, no lines, no dot marker. At the bottom left and right, on the page margins, sit the legal line and an Image credits link at body size. Each name is a 44px-tall target. Phone: Names in a vertical list at the sub step with the active one in full ink; the arc is dropped.
signature: Five page names on a half-ellipse (800x400) above the bottom edge: the active one sits at the top of the arc in full ink, and hover or the arrow keys turn the arc to bring another up.
phone: Names in a vertical list at the sub step with the active one in full ink; the arc is dropped.
avoidWith: a radial navigation in the header
houseRuleCheck: Designed out: the clock id and the hands, the accent dot (a drawn shape; the active name takes full ink), the 40%-ink names (contrast), the 14px credit row. Keep the header navigation plain; the arc lives only here.

name: Big link list over shader band
description: A footer of about 760px at 1440 (its content height, under one screen) on the ink or the surface tone as its own ground, with the page margin as side padding and 96px top padding. Left column (700px): four or five links set at the head step in the display face, 16px apart, no rules between them; they are the site's other pages where it has them (contact, journal, press, careers), and on a one-page site its own sections and the contact, each a real destination, never a dead link. Hover shifts the hovered link 16px to the right and tints it with the accent while the others dim to the muted ink. Middle column (x 880, 300px wide): one plain status sentence at body size (no pill, no fill, such as open for new work), the contact line at the lead step, the address at body size. Right column (x 1240): three secondary links at body size. 64px lower a row: a live local clock at the left, a Back to top text link in the centre, the copyright and an Image credits link at the right, body size. At the end a band 200px tall, inset by the page margin with the dealt corner, holds a shader field in two flat palette tones (the ground and the surface tone) whose boundary is warped slowly by noise (hard-edged, no colour ramps) and one short closing line at the head step in the centre, kept clear of the boundary. Everything is there at once (the dealt entrance). Phone: Links at the sub step in one column, contact blocks below, the band 160px with the line at the lead step.
signature: A link list set at head size that dims its neighbours on hover, above a 200px inset band whose two-tone shader boundary is warped slowly by noise and carries one closing line, all under one screen.
phone: Links at the sub step in one column, contact blocks below, the band 160px with the line at the lead step.
houseRuleCheck: Designed out: the content rising with the scroll (the dealt entrance), the filled status pill (a plain sentence), the 52-56px bold links (head step), the 14px rows (body size), the menu as the big list. The shader uses two flat tones with a warped edge, so it is not a gradient; no rules; the band carries one short line.

name: Identity left, info stack right
description: A split footer as tall as its right-hand stack, about 640px at 1440, on its own ground (the surface tone or the ink), with the page margin as side padding and 96px top and bottom padding. The left third (440px wide) holds the identity: the brand mark (typeset or supplied, 72-96px high) and under it a two-line statement at the head step in the display face. The right two thirds start at x 520 and stack three blocks on a 64px step: contact (the email as a plain link at the sub step, the phone at the lead step), address and hours at the lead step, then link groups at body size on a 220px pitch. The social and legal links and Image credits sit at the foot on one body-size line, spread left and right. Colour roles: the dealt ground and ink; the accent only for the hover and the email underline. Everything is there at once (the dealt entrance). Phone: Identity block first, then the stack as one column with 40px gaps; social and legal links stack.
signature: Identity in the left third (a mark and a two-line head-step statement) against a right-hand stack that starts at x 520 with the email as a plain link at the sub step, then address, hours and link groups, with no link columns across the full width.
phone: Identity block first, then the stack as one column with 40px gaps; social and legal links stack.
houseRuleCheck: Designed out: the stack rising on enter (the dealt entrance), the 840px height (content height) and the 16px-or-smaller social and legal line. A large wordmark in the left third would be the banned giant footer name, and rules between the blocks are hairlines: the left holds a small mark and a statement, the blocks are separated by space, the email stays at the sub step.

name: Centred call over directory band
description: A footer uncovered from under the page, as tall as its content, about 640px at 1440 (never padded to a full screen): it sits fixed behind the end of the main content, which carries a bottom margin equal to the footer's height, so the last section lifts off it like a sheet. Its own ground is the ink (or the surface tone). Upper part: a centred two-line headline at the display step in the display face, and 40px beneath it the dealt button with its trailing arrow. 96px lower a band: at the left the logo lockup (40px high) over one plain status line at body size, in the centre three link columns on a 200px pitch (titles at the lead step in the strong weight, body-size links), at the right a row of social text links; 64px lower a split row at body size (copyright and legal links at the left, Image credits at the right). Hover moves the button's arrow 6px. The headline is there at once (the dealt entrance). Phone: Headline at the head step, the button full width, link columns 2-up, the band stacks; the reveal is dropped and the footer scrolls in normally.
signature: The last section lifts off a fixed footer like a sheet, uncovering a centred two-line display headline with the dealt button above a single band of logo, link columns and social links.
phone: Headline at the head step, the button full width, link columns 2-up, the band stacks; the reveal is dropped and the footer scrolls in normally.
houseRuleCheck: Designed out: the 100vh footer (content height; a fixed reveal only works when the footer fits the viewport), the accent fully rounded button (the dealt button), the filled status pill (a plain line), the lines rising on enter (the dealt entrance). The headline is one plain style with no accent word.

name: Emblem with side links
description: A closing section as tall as its content, about 760px at 1440, on the ink or the surface tone as its own ground. A centred emblem about 560px wide, 80px from the top, stands alone: a cut-out object on a transparent background (the brand symbol or one rendered or photographed object, never a wordmark). It is there at once (the dealt entrance). Along the bottom a link row at body size with the page margin as side padding, 40px bottom padding and 32px gaps: text links (contact and the main pages) at the left, the legal links and an Image credits link at the right. A short column of three to five social text links stands near the right edge at the emblem's mid-height, on the page margin, body size, stacked top to bottom. Letters in the colour that reads on that ground; the accent colours the hovered link only. Phone: Emblem at 70% of the width; the link row wraps into two rows and the social links join the bottom row.
signature: One 560px cut-out object centred alone on the footer's flat ground (the ink or the surface tone), with a bottom link row split left and right and a short stack of social text links at the right edge.
phone: Emblem at 70% of the width; the link row wraps into two rows and the social links join the bottom row.
houseRuleCheck: Designed out: the blur-and-scale fade-in (the dealt entrance), the 100vh screen (content height), the id's rail (a plain stack of text links). A soft radial halo would be a gradient: the ground is flat. The emblem is a symbol or an object, never a wordmark.

name: Headline over photo row
description: On the surface tone as its own ground, as tall as its content, about 860px at 1440, 120px top padding. A centred two-line headline at the display step in the display face, and 24px under it one text link with an accent underline. 80px lower a row of five photographs inside the page margins: squares of 200px and 240px alternating, 32px gaps, the dealt corner, offset vertically 0 and 40px in a gentle wave; they are photographs the page has not shown above. 64px under the row, two text links (the social links as words) centred, 40px apart. On scroll the photographs drift against each other (the even ones 40px left, the odd ones 40px right, tied to scroll, never crossing the page margins); hover scales one photograph to 1.06. A body-size legal line with an Image credits link sits 48px from the bottom. Ink on the surface tone, the accent only on the link underline. Reduced motion: the row stays still. Phone: Photographs in a 2-up staggered grid of four; the links stack.
signature: A row of five square photographs (200 and 240px alternating, offset 0 and 40px in a wave) under a centred two-line display headline, drifting against each other as the footer scrolls.
phone: Photographs in a 2-up staggered grid of four; the links stack.
houseRuleCheck: Designed out: the id's edge cut (the row stays inside the margins, never cut by a screen edge), the 54px headline and the one-screen height (display step, two lines, content height), the two filled pills (text links), the 20px corners (the dealt corner). Photographs are art-directed, never archive or documentary shots, each used once on the page.

name: Centred logo and link row over columns
description: A filled panel on the surface tone, inset by the page margin, in the dealt corner, as tall as its content, about 700px at 1440, with 120px top padding. A centred logo lockup 56px high; 56px below it a centred row of up to seven primary links in the strong weight at the lead step on a 160px pitch (the site's other pages where it has them; on a one-page site its own sections and the contact; never a dead link), hover underlining in the ink. 96px under that, three left-aligned link columns on a 300px pitch starting at x 160 (titles at the lead step in the strong weight, body-size links), and at the far right a Back to top text link. The last row sits 80px below: the legal line at the left, the social text links and an Image credits link at the right, body size. Ink is the dealt ink on the surface tone. Phone: Lockup and primary links in a 2-up grid; columns stack.
signature: A filled panel inset from the page margins in the dealt corner, with a centred logo and a centred row of bold links over three link columns, so the footer reads as one rounded panel and not a full-width bar.
phone: Lockup and primary links in a 2-up grid; columns stack.
houseRuleCheck: Designed out: the soft-tint variant with 50px top corners rising into view (a second radius and its own entrance), the 56px round back-to-top disc (a text link), the brand colour as the panel's ground (the surface tone). A rule and a row of membership marks would break the hairline and logo-wall bans; both are left out. The panel is one card, not boxes in boxes.

name: Picture with scattered contacts
description: On the ink ground (or the surface tone), as tall as its content, about 960px at 1440. A centred picture 440px wide starts at y 120: one photograph or one rendered object in the dealt picture grade (never a drawn illustration, never greyed). Contact items are scattered around it in a loose, asymmetric ring with 80-160px gaps: the email at the upper left (sub step), the phone at the lower right (sub step), the city and hours as two body-size lines, three social links at body size, each its own small block in sentence case. No connecting lines. A body-size legal line with an Image credits link sits at the bottom left. On scroll the picture drifts up slower than the page (parallax 0.85); hover tints an item with the accent. Letters in the ground colour on the ink, or in the ink on the surface tone. Phone: Picture at 70% width; items stack in one centred column, 24px apart: email, phone, city, social.
signature: Contact details scattered in a loose ring (80-160px gaps) around one 440px centred picture, in place of columns of links.
phone: Picture at 70% width; items stack in one centred column, 24px apart: email, phone, city, social.
houseRuleCheck: Designed out: the drawn halftone illustration and the single-ink toning (the dealt picture grade, never greyed), the items sliding in (the dealt entrance), the 1,350px height (content height), small uppercase labels. Items are sentence case at body size or larger; the email stays at the sub step, never giant; never an archive or documentary photograph.

name: Statement with cycling word
description: On the ink as its own ground (letters in the ground colour), as tall as its content, about 560px at 1440. 120px from the top a centred statement of two lines at the display step in the display face. One word in the second line cycles through three to five alternatives (a vertical roll, 400ms, every 2.4s) and is set in the same colour, weight and size as the rest. 96px lower, centred: a small brand mark (28-40px high), under it one row of three or four text links at body size (contact and pages), then a body-size legal line with an Image credits link and a Back to top text link. No empty pause: each element sits within 96px of the next. Reduced motion: the first alternative stays. Phone: Statement at the head step on two lines, the same bottom group.
signature: A centred two-line display statement whose last word rolls through three to five alternatives every 2.4 seconds, over one small mark and a single row of links.
phone: Statement at the head step on two lines, the same bottom group.
houseRuleCheck: Designed out: the 54px three-line statement (two lines at the display step), the 300px empty pause, the 14px legal text. The cycling word keeps the headline style, so it is not a styled accent word, and its roll is a loop, not an entrance. A pull-up handle is a drag device and is left out.

name: Centred video tile
description: On the surface tone as its own ground, as tall as its content, about 740px at 1440. A video tile 830x468 (16:9, the dealt corner) is centred at y 120 and loops muted at rest. The dealt button reading Play, with a typeset play glyph before the word, sits at its centre; a click opens the film in a lightbox with sound. 64px under the tile, on one line at body size: the legal line with an Image credits link at the left margin, two text links centred as a pair with a 40px gap, and one archive link at the right margin. Hover scales the tile to 1.02. Phone: Tile fills the width minus the page margins; the links stack.
signature: One 830x468 muted looping film tile centred in the footer with the dealt button reading Play at its centre, opening the film in a lightbox, with only a legal line and two links around it.
phone: Tile fills the width minus the page margins; the links stack.
avoidWith: a video hero directly at the top of the page
houseRuleCheck: As tall as its content; the bottom row is body size; a flat ground from the palette. The play control is the dealt button, never a second round shape; the legal line at the left keeps the bottom row from being empty at the left.

name: Stage with link selector
description: A final stage as tall as its content, about 660px at 1440, on the ink or surface-tone ground: one 3D object (a model, or a turntable render clip) stands on a plinth at the centre and turns slowly. At the bottom centre, 56px up, three link labels at the sub step form a selector: the middle one is active, in the accent, the outer two in the muted ink. Hover or tap on a label (or the arrow keys) steps the selector; each step swaps the object's pose or material with a 600ms turn, and the active label is the page link. No prev and next buttons. The legal line with an Image credits link sits in the bottom left corner and the social text links in the bottom right, body size. Phone: Object at 70% of the stage height; only the active label shows, and a tap steps it.
signature: A turning 3D object on a plinth with three link labels beneath it at the sub step; the active one in the accent steps the object's pose or material.
phone: Object at 70% of the stage height; only the active label shows, and a tap steps it.
houseRuleCheck: Designed out: the 100vh stage (content height), the prev and next disc buttons (the labels are the control), the filled accent pill on the active label (its letters take the accent), the 14px corner text. Needs a real 3D asset or turntable render; if none exists, do not deal it.

name: Closing display headline
description: The page ends on a closing section as tall as its content, about 520px at 1440 (never a pinned or held scene), on one flat field (the dealt field colour: the ink as ground, lettered in the ground colour). The main element is one centred headline at the display step, two lines at most, two or three words per line, tight leading (0.95), one style, high contrast. It is never the brand name or the hero headline. It has 120px of padding above and 96px below. Under it one working row at body size: the legal line with an Image credits link at the left, two or three contact or page links at the right. No link columns. The headline is there at once (the dealt entrance). Phone: Headline at the head step, two lines at most; the working row stacks.
signature: A centred two-line display headline alone on a flat field, with one working row under it (legal at the left, two or three links at the right) and no link columns.
phone: Headline at the head step, two lines at most; the working row stacks.
avoidWith: a final call-to-action section directly above that repeats the line
houseRuleCheck: Designed out: the 160-200vh pinned scene (a footer is content height), the 150-200px headline (display step), the word-by-word reveal (the dealt entrance). The headline is allowed; a giant brand name or email is not. The working row keeps it a footer that works rather than a page that just stops.

name: Colour sheet, display headline
description: A colour sheet as tall as its content, about 640px at 1440, in the dealt field colour (the ink as ground, lettered in the ground colour), whose top corners take the dealt corner radius and overlap the section above (the sheet lifts over the previous ground). 96px top padding, the page margin as side padding. Top row: a paragraph at the lead step (max 360px), the dealt button and two link columns on a 200px pitch (body-size links). 96px lower, a left-aligned two-line headline at the display step in the display face, with an address block (body size, three lines) and one contact link at the sub step in a column beside it at the right. The bottom row, spread at body size: the legal line with an Image credits link at the left, a small brand mark in the centre, social links at the right. Phone: Headline at the head step, the top row stacked, address below, bottom row stacked.
signature: A footer sheet whose rounded top corners overlap the section above, carrying a left-aligned two-line display headline with the address and one contact link beside it.
phone: Headline at the head step, the top row stacked, address below, bottom row stacked.
houseRuleCheck: Designed out: the 100vh sheet (content height), the 48px top corners (the dealt corner), the 140px headline (display step), the saturated colour (the field colour, one accent hue), the sheet's own button (the dealt button). The email stays at link size, never set giant.

name: Corner link, logo and tagline
description: A sparse footer as tall as its content, about 520px at 1440, on the ink as its own ground (letters in the ground colour). One link at the sub step with a corner arrow (a text link, not a button) sits on the centre line (x 720), 96px from the top, the accent only on the arrow. 96px lower the brand logo (300-360px wide as supplied, or the name set in the display face at the head step) stands at the left margin and a two-line tagline at the head step starts at the centre line (x 720). 96px under them a body-size row carries the legal line with an Image credits link and two contact links. Everything else is open ground, with no stretch of it taller than 96px. Hover moves the arrow 8px diagonally. Phone: Link, then logo, then tagline, stacked with 64px gaps.
signature: One sub-step link with a corner arrow on the centre line, then the logo at the left margin and a two-line tagline on the centre line below it, on the ink, with nothing else on it.
phone: Link, then logo, then tagline, stacked with 64px gaps.
houseRuleCheck: Designed out: the nearly empty 100vh screen (content height, no empty stretch over 96px), the 14px row (body size). A logo built of horizontal bars would be a drawn shape: use the supplied mark or plain type, under 40% of the width, so it is not a giant name.

name: Prompt band over directory card
description: Two filled surfaces stacked flush, inside the page margins, as tall as their content, about 560px at 1440. First a band 96px tall in the dealt field colour (the ink as ground, lettered in the ground colour) with the dealt corner on its top corners: a one-line prompt at the lead step at the left and the dealt button at the right. Directly under it a card on the surface tone, about 440px tall, with the dealt corner on its bottom corners: the logo (36px high), four link columns on a 229px pitch (titles at the lead step in the strong weight, body-size links) and a bottom row at body size with the legal line and an Image credits link at the left and one plain text link at the right (never a second button to the same place). Filled surfaces only, no outlines, no rules. Hover darkens the band one step and moves the button's arrow 6px. Phone: The band stacks prompt over button; the card columns go 2-up.
signature: Two filled surfaces butted together: a 96px field-colour band holding a prompt and the dealt button sits directly on the surface-tone directory card, so the pair reads as one rounded block.
phone: The band stacks prompt over button; the card columns go 2-up.
houseRuleCheck: Designed out: the accent as the band's ground (the field colour), the split pill button with its darker arrow cell and the second split button (the dealt button and a text link), the 14px row. Two filled surfaces side by side, not nested; no outlines or rules.

name: Call left, link grid right
description: A footer split in halves, as tall as its content, about 580px at 1440, on the surface tone or the ink as its own ground, with the page margin as side padding and 120px top padding. Left half (x 64-700): a two-line call to action at the display step in the display face (one style) and, 48px under it, the dealt button. Right half (from x 780): a one-sentence intro at the lead step, then 64px lower a 2x2 grid of link groups (social, pages, location, email), each a title at the lead step in the strong weight over body-size links 8px apart, 64px column gap, 56px row gap. A body-size legal line with an Image credits link sits at the bottom left, 64px under the content. Letters in the colour that reads on that ground, the accent only on the button. Everything is there at once (the dealt entrance). Phone: Headline at the head step, the grid stays 2 columns, the button full width.
signature: A two-line display call to action with the dealt button on the left half against a one-sentence intro and a 2x2 grid of link groups on the right half.
phone: Headline at the head step, the grid stays 2 columns, the button full width.
houseRuleCheck: Designed out: the 96px three-line headline (two lines at the display step), the empty ground down to 100vh (content height), the clip-rise and fade-rise on enter (the dealt entrance), the pill button (the dealt button). The email stays a normal link, never giant; the headline is one style with no accent word.

name: Directory over last frame
description: The footer content sits on one full-bleed dark photograph, as tall as its content, about 720px at 1440: the page film's last frame or one render, held still. The picture is dark where the type stands by its own exposure (no overlay, no scrim, no gradient laid over it) and all type sits on its calm part. At the left, on the page margin and bottom-aligned, a one-sentence quote at the sub step (three lines at most). At the right a two-line heading at the head step and under it two link columns on a 240px pitch at body size. Above them three or four text links at body size, 32px apart (the site's other pages, or its sections on a one-page site). A bottom row spread wide at body size: the legal links and an Image credits link at the left, the copyright at the right. Light ink over the dark photograph; no card over it. Phone: Quote and heading stack; the links wrap onto one or two lines; link columns 2-up.
signature: The directory stands directly on a full-bleed dark photograph, a still of the last scene, with a quote at the bottom left and a heading and link columns at the right and no panel between type and picture.
phone: Quote and heading stack; the links wrap onto one or two lines; link columns 2-up.
houseRuleCheck: Designed out: the rising 70% dark overlay (a wash laid over a photograph; the picture is dark by its own exposure), the 100vh height, the 3-line 40px heading (two lines at the head step), the scene links that jump back, the progress rail and the rule. Text never sits on a busy part of the picture.

name: Directory over phrase marquee
description: A compact directory over a full-width moving band, about 500px in all at 1440, with the page margin as side padding. Directory (about 280px, on the surface tone): at the left a call line at the sub step in the display face with the contact link under it; in the middle two link columns on a 240px pitch at body size; at the right a signup, a filled email field in the dealt corner joined to the dealt button (the page's one email form). 96px lower the band is 120-140px tall and full-bleed, filled in the dealt field colour (the ink as ground, lettered in the ground colour). In it a short invitation phrase of two to four words (never the brand name or an email) is set at the display step in the display face, repeated with a 64px gap, and slides left in a continuous loop at 60-90px per second. Hover slows the band to a stop; the whole band is one link to the contact page. Reduced motion: one still instance of the phrase, centred. Phone: The directory stacks (call line, link columns 2-up, signup full width). The band drops to 72px with the phrase at the head step and a slower loop.
signature: A full-width band 120-140px tall in the flipped ground whose two-to-four-word invitation at display size slides left without stopping and slows to a halt on hover; the whole band is one link.
phone: The directory stacks (call line, link columns 2-up, signup full width). The band drops to 72px with the phrase at the head step and a slower loop.
avoidWith: another marquee band directly above the footer
a signup or newsletter section elsewhere on the page
houseRuleCheck: Designed out: the accent as a text ground (the band takes the field colour), the pill field and button (the dealt corner and button), a phrase larger than the display step. Sliding the brand name would be the banned giant footer name: the band slides an invitation. A marquee is not a drag rail; no rules.

name: Directory, colour panel, monogram
description: On the ink as its own ground (letters in the ground colour), as tall as its content, about 780px at 1440, with the page margin as padding. Top left: a name line at body size and under it a two-line heading at the head step, with a signup beneath it (the page's one email form: a filled email field in the dealt corner joined to the dealt button). At the right two link columns (x 900 and 1120, body-size links), with a row of social text links at mid-height. The lower half is a pair of blocks: at the left a monogram, the brand's one-letter mark (supplied, or the first letter set as a logo) 240px high in the accent, never the full name; at the bottom right a flat panel about 560x360 on the surface tone in the dealt corner, holding a two-line call to action at the sub step in the ink and a text link with an arrow under it. A body-size legal line with an Image credits link sits under the monogram at the bottom left. Hover steps the panel one tone. Phone: Panel first at full width, 320px high, monogram 160px, columns 2-up.
signature: A flat call-to-action panel (about 560x360, surface tone) at the bottom right of a footer on the ink, balanced at the left by a single 240px accent letter of the brand, over a newsletter heading and link columns.
phone: Panel first at full width, 320px high, monogram 160px, columns 2-up.
avoidWith: a signup or newsletter section elsewhere on the page
houseRuleCheck: Designed out: the gradient in the id (the panel is flat), the accent as the panel's ground (the surface tone; one accent hue), the panel's own pill (a text link, so no second button to another place), the 687x439 size and the monogram's turn on hover. The monogram is one letter or the supplied mark, never a drawn illustration and never the full name.

name: Display word left with button
description: As tall as its content, about 440px at 1440, on the ink ground, with 96px top and bottom padding and the page margin as side padding. One word at the display step in the display face, left-aligned at the page margin, in the ground colour or the ink, one style: a verb or short invitation, never the brand name. 40px beneath it the dealt button, at the left. No link columns: a body-size row along the bottom carries the legal line, an Image credits link and two contact links. The word is there at once (the dealt entrance). Phone: Word at the head step on one or two lines; the button full width.
signature: One display-step verb set flush left on the margin with the dealt button 40px under it and a bare legal row at the foot, and no link columns.
phone: Word at the head step on one or two lines; the button full width.
houseRuleCheck: Designed out: the 20vw giant word (display step), the 100vh height (content height), the pill (the dealt button), the sound or theme toggle (a switch that changes nothing unless the page has sound), the clip-rise reveal and the held last scene (the dealt entrance). The word is a verb or an invitation, never the brand name.

name: Final stage with corner bar
description: The page ends on a moving picture that is the footer: a full-bleed film band 560-640px tall at 1440 (never a full screen), a looping film or a turntable render clip that keeps moving slowly (a camera drift or a turn) and carries no content block. Optionally one headline at the head step (one style) sits centred at 55% of the band's height and works as a link to continue: an accent underline grows under it on hover and a click goes to the top of the page. Along the bottom of the band runs a 64px bar with the page margin as side padding and no panel behind it, text in light ink at body size: the legal line and an Image credits link at the left, three to five social or contact text links 24px apart at the right. Keep the lower 120px of the film dark (the scene's own floor or ground, never a gradient scrim) so the bar reads. The band is there at once (the dealt entrance); a fixed bottom dock stays where it is. Phone: Band 70svh; headline at the sub step; the bar becomes two lines (legal above, links below) with 16px padding.
signature: The footer is a moving picture: a full-bleed film band about 600px tall, looping, with one head-step link headline and the legal and contact links along its dark floor.
phone: Band 70svh; headline at the sub step; the bar becomes two lines (legal above, links below) with 16px padding.
houseRuleCheck: Designed out: the 100vh stage (a 600px band), the fade-in and 600ms wipe (the dealt entrance), the swap of the dock's controls, the 14px bar text. Social and contact are text links; no rail, progress indicator, glass or scrim; the film's own dark floor sits under the bar.

name: Headline, links, newsletter row
description: A footer as tall as its content, about 640px at 1440, on the ink or surface-tone ground, with the page margin as side padding and 96px top padding. Row one: at the left a two-line headline at the head step (max 560px) with a text link and arrow under it; at x 760 two link columns on a 233px pitch (titles at the lead step in the strong weight, body-size links). 96px lower a signup row: a heading at the lead step at the left, a 48px email field (filled in the surface tone, the dealt corner) joined to the dealt button; it is the page's one email form. 96px lower a legal row spread across the width at body size, with an Image credits link. Rows are separated by space only. Phone: Headline, link, link columns 2-up, then the field above its button.
signature: A two-line head-step headline over a joined email row, with two link columns at x 760, and the email field with its button as the only filled controls.
phone: Headline, link, link columns 2-up, then the field above its button.
avoidWith: a signup or newsletter section elsewhere on the page
houseRuleCheck: Designed out: the 200x120 looping video thumbnail (a small picture filling a gap), the sliding-over entrance (the dealt entrance), the lighter-tone filled pill under the headline (a text link), the fully rounded field and submit (the dealt corner and button). Spacing replaces the rule.

name: Headline and render over link columns
description: On the ink ground, as tall as its content, about 760px at 1440, uncovered from under the previous section (the footer sits fixed behind the end of the main content, which slides up off it; it fits the viewport). Upper left (x 64, from y 96): a two-line headline at the display step in the display face (one style, at most 620px wide) with a two-line paragraph at the lead step (max 460px) 24px beneath it. Upper right: a looping render of the product's object in a 560px square (a transparent-background clip), its right side on the page margin, from y 80, never touching the text. Lower left, 80px under the paragraph: three link columns on a 220px pitch from x 64 (titles at the lead step in the strong weight, body-size links), clear of the render. A body-size legal row with an Image credits link spreads across the bottom. Pointer movement tilts the render by up to 6 degrees. Phone: Render at 70% width above the headline (head step); columns 2-up; the reveal is dropped and the footer scrolls in normally.
signature: A 560px square looping render of the product's object at the upper right of a dark footer, with a two-line display headline and link columns clear of it, uncovered from under the page.
phone: Render at 70% width above the headline (head step); columns 2-up; the reveal is dropped and the footer scrolls in normally.
houseRuleCheck: Designed out: the rule above the links (the id's 'ruled'), the 128-144px headline (display step), the 100vh height (content height). The render stays inside the margin and clear of the headline, never clipped by the screen edge. Needs a real 3D asset or turntable clip; if none, do not deal it.

name: Panel with centred render
description: A filled panel on the surface tone, inset by the page margin, in the dealt corner, as tall as its content, about 760px at 1440. At the top centre a small brand mark (36px high) and a centred two-line statement at the head step (max 520px). A cut-out object (a render or photograph on a transparent background, never a drawn shape) rises from the bottom centre, about 620px wide, and is cropped by the panel's bottom edge, never the screen edge. A link column sits at the left of it (x 280, five links at body size on a 44px step, the legal links and an Image credits link at the foot) and a social column at the right (x 1160, four links at body size). The object follows the pointer by up to 8 degrees; nothing else moves. Phone: Statement, then the object at 60% width cropped by the panel bottom, the two columns in a row above it.
signature: A 620px cut-out object rises from the bottom centre of an inset surface-tone panel and is cropped by the panel's bottom edge, flanked by a link column at the left and a social column at the right, tilting up to 8 degrees with the pointer.
phone: Statement, then the object at 60% width cropped by the panel bottom, the two columns in a row above it.
houseRuleCheck: Designed out: the 10px idle float (the pointer tilt is the only motion), the 880px height (content height), the darker tint (the one surface tone). The raised tab is left out; the crop is the panel's edge, never the screen edge. One panel, not boxes in boxes.

name: Link columns plus newsletter
description: A directory with its own signup column, as tall as its content, 400-480px at 1440 (never padded with empty ground), on the ink as its own ground (letters in the ground colour), with the page margin as side padding. Three link columns on a 200px pitch (titles at the lead step in the strong weight, links at body size), the links never the menu again. The last column, 380px wide, is a filled card on the surface tone in the dealt corner with 32px padding, holding a two-line heading at the lead step and a joined email field (48px tall, the dealt corner) and the dealt button: the page's one email form. 96px below, a utility row: the copyright at the left, two or three links (legal, Image credits) at the right, body size. Colour roles: the ink as ground, the surface tone for the card, the accent on the button and the link hover only. Hover takes a link to its full colour. Phone: The signup card moves first, full width; the link columns follow 2-up; the utility row stacks.
signature: A signup card on the surface tone, 380px wide, as the last column beside three link columns on the ink.
phone: The signup card moves first, full width; the link columns follow 2-up; the utility row stacks.
avoidWith: a signup or newsletter section elsewhere on the page
houseRuleCheck: Designed out: the slim 260px version and the tall version with calm empty ground (content height, 400-480px), the pill select and the 14px utility row, the card's own tint and hover (the one surface tone). The signup card is filled, never outlined.

name: Link columns with legal tiers
description: A directory footer as tall as its content, about 640-760px at 1440, on its own ground (the surface tone or the ink), with the page margin as side padding and 96px top padding; content starts at the left margin. Three to five link columns share the content width on a 240-300px pitch. Each opens with a title at the lead step in the strong weight, then links at body size on a 36px step in the muted ink. The links are the site's other pages where it has them (company, legal, support) and the social links as text; on a one-page site the columns hold its own sections, the contact and the social links; never a dead link. Hover turns a link to full ink and grows an accent underline in from the left. Column one can be the brand column: the mark 40-56px high (typeset or supplied), one short sentence at body size and a text link, 320px wide, with the link columns starting at x 480. 96px lower comes a tier of two or three office or contact blocks (three lines each, body size), and 96px lower the legal row: the copyright at the left, the policy links and Image credits at the right, body size in the muted ink. Tiers are separated by space only. No headline. Colour roles: the dealt ground, ink text, the accent only for the hover underline. Phone: Columns become a 2-up grid with titles at body size in the strong weight, the brand column first at full width when used; contact blocks stack in one column with 40px gaps; the legal row stacks and left-aligns.
signature: Three tiers separated by 96px of space only: link columns (with an optional brand column at the left), a tier of office or contact blocks, then a legal row, with no headline and no rules.
phone: Columns become a 2-up grid with titles at body size in the strong weight, the brand column first at full width when used; contact blocks stack in one column with 40px gaps; the legal row stacks and left-aligns.
avoidWith: a dense card grid directly above
houseRuleCheck: Designed out: the rule over the legal row, the social badge strip, the language pill and 14px legal text (tiers are space only, social is text links, the legal row is body size), and links that repeat the menu. The brand column's sentence stays one sentence.

name: Link groups over address line
description: On the surface tone as its own ground, as tall as its content, about 700px at 1440, with the page margin as padding, on a 12-column grid. Three link groups (the site's pages or its sections, social, external) in columns 1-4, 5-8 and 9-12, each with a title at the lead step in the strong weight over its links at body size on a 38px step, no rules under the titles. About 120px lower the place line (the street on one line, the city and country on the next, two lines at most) is set at the head step in the display face with tight leading, spanning the grid width. The place is the big line, never the brand name; the phone and email stay body-size links in the groups above. At the bottom, body size: the legal line with an Image credits link at the left and the year at the right. Hover dims the other links of a group to the muted ink; the place line tints to the accent on hover as a map link. Phone: Groups stack; the place line at the sub step.
signature: The address, street and city on two lines at the head step across the full grid width and linked to a map, under three link groups on the surface tone.
phone: Groups stack; the place line at the sub step.
houseRuleCheck: The address line is two lines at the head step, never larger and never the brand name, the email or the phone; no rules under the titles, no glyph icons; the bottom line is body size.

name: News feed footer
description: On the ink ground, as tall as its content, about 1,100px at 1440, with the page margin as side padding. The left half (x 64-600) is sticky for the length of the feed: a two-line heading at the head step (the signup promise), under it a joined email field and the dealt button (48px tall; the page's one email form), then social links and small links at body size and the legal line with an Image credits link, so the left is never empty. The right half (from x 725) holds a feed of four filled cards on the surface tone in the dealt corner, 16px apart: two cards with a 224px square photograph at the left, a date in sentence case at body size, a title at the lead step and two lines of body text; then two text-only cards in the same fill. No chips, no rules. Hover steps the card one tone and scales the photograph to 1.04. Never repeat a feed the page already shows. Phone: The sticky block becomes the top block; cards stack with a 96px photograph at the left of each.
signature: A sticky left half (the signup promise at the head step, a joined email field and the dealt button) beside a right-hand feed of four dated filled cards, two of them with 224px square photographs.
phone: The sticky block becomes the top block; cards stack with a 96px photograph at the left of each.
avoidWith: a news or journal section on the same page
a signup or newsletter section elsewhere on the page
houseRuleCheck: Designed out: the status chips (a plain date), the 1.6-screen height (content height), the fade-rise on enter (the dealt entrance), hairline-divided rows and an almost empty left half (filled cards and a sticky left block). Two lines of text per card; each photograph once on the page.

name: Panel lifts over colour floor
description: A two-layer curtain footer as tall as its content. Layer one is a filled panel on the surface tone in the dealt corner, inset by the page margin, about 450px tall with 56px padding, holding a one-line brand sentence at the lead step at the left and three link columns on a 160px pitch (body-size links), with the copyright and legal row at body size below. As the panel scrolls up it uncovers a floor behind it (sticky or fixed behind), 380-420px tall, in the dealt field colour (the ink as ground, lettered in the ground colour). On the floor sit a centred line at the head step in the display face (two lines at most); a row of two or three live values as plain body-size words on one baseline, 40px apart, refreshed every minute (the local time at the maker, open or closed now only when the subject has opening hours, the year or the season; drop any the subject lacks, keep at least two); and a small centred mark 40px above the bottom. No chips, no pills, no fills behind the values. The lift is the only motion. Phone: Panel inset 24px with the columns 2-up; floor line at the sub step; the values wrap into two centred lines; the floor stays about 360px tall.
signature: A curtain: a surface-tone panel lifts off a field-colour floor about 400px tall, uncovering one display-step line and two or three live values (local time, open or closed, the year).
phone: Panel inset 24px with the columns 2-up; floor line at the sub step; the values wrap into two centred lines; the floor stays about 360px tall.
houseRuleCheck: Designed out: the fixed 100vh floor holding one line (now about 400px), the filled chips (plain words, never a counter), the accent as the floor's ground (the field colour), 'open or closed now' for a subject without opening hours. The panel is one card over a floor, not boxes in boxes.

name: Photo band over directory row
description: As tall as its content, about 900px at 1440. A photograph (art-directed, in the dealt grade, never documentary) fills the top band, about 560px, inside the page margins with the dealt corner; no tint, wash or overlay is laid on it, so the statement sits on its calm part. At its upper left (48px in) a two-line statement at the display step in the ink that contrasts with the picture, and under it the dealt button; these are the only elements on the photograph. The bottom row sits on the page ground with the page margin as padding: the logo lockup (36px) at the left; three groups of links on a 220px pitch and a filled signup card on the surface tone in the dealt corner (360px wide; the page's one email form, with the dealt button) at the right; 64px under it a body-size legal row with an Image credits link. The photograph drifts 8% slower than the scroll. Phone: The photograph is 420px high with the statement at the head step; the row stacks.
signature: A 560px inset photograph in the dealt corner carrying a two-line display statement and the dealt button, directly above the logo, three link groups and a signup card on the ground.
phone: The photograph is 420px high with the statement at the head step; the row stacks.
avoidWith: a signup or newsletter section elsewhere on the page
houseRuleCheck: Designed out: the 30% dark tint over the photograph (a wash; the statement sits on a calm part), the 360x72 accent pill (the dealt button), the 64px statement (display step). A large wordmark on the photo would be the giant footer name: a statement replaces it. Only the statement and one button sit on the photograph, never a card.

name: Colophon with photo
description: On the surface tone as its own ground, an 8-column grid with the page margins, as tall as its content, about 440px at 1440 with 96px vertical padding. Columns 1-2: a 209x279 portrait-format photograph (the maker or the place, the dealt corner) with a two-line caption at body size under it. Columns 5-6 and 7-8: two 315px text columns at body size on 1.5 leading. The first holds a heading at the lead step and one short paragraph with an inline link underlined in the accent; the second holds three label-value contact groups, each label a body-size word in the strong weight (for example studio) over its value, 24px apart, then the legal line with an Image credits link. Everything is there at once (the dealt entrance). Phone: Single column: photograph at 60% width, then the two text blocks.
signature: A small 3:4 portrait photograph with a two-line caption at the left of a quiet two-column colophon (one short paragraph, three label-value contact groups), with no link columns.
phone: Single column: photograph at 60% width, then the two text blocks.
houseRuleCheck: Designed out: the 36px margins (the page margins), the lines rising on enter (the dealt entrance), the 14px legal line (body size). Bracket characters around the heading and tiny uppercase labels are left out; keep to one short paragraph. The photograph is crafted, never an archive shot.

name: Physics pile of word tiles
description: A footer as tall as its stage, about 560px at 1440, on the ink ground, holding a physics pile of about 16 tiles (rectangles in the dealt corner, 64-96px tall, in a few widths), all filled with the one surface tone. Each tile carries one lowercase word in the display face at the lead step (page names, values or verbs); the tiles that are page links take the accent for their letters, never a second fill. The pile is already settled when it comes into view (nothing falls in); the pointer can push the tiles (restitution 0.3, resting angles up to 20 degrees), and a click on a link tile navigates. A row of social text links at the bottom left and the legal line with an Image credits link at the bottom right, body size. Needs a small physics engine (about 30kB). Reduced motion: the tiles stay as settled and do not move. Phone: Ten tiles, 56px tall; the links row above the pile.
signature: Sixteen word tiles in one surface tone lie in a settled physics pile on a dark stage; the pointer pushes them and the accent-lettered ones are the page links.
phone: Ten tiles, 56px tall; the links row above the pile.
avoidWith: another physics scene on the page
houseRuleCheck: Designed out: the three tones plus the accent as fills (one surface tone, accent letters; no wall of tiles in several fills), the full-screen height (content height), the drop-in on enter (the dealt entrance), the 14px legal line. Plain word tiles that double as the sitemap, never logo tiles or shield shapes.

name: Scattered cut-outs over signup
description: A footer in the dealt field colour (the ink as ground, lettered in the ground colour) with the dealt corner on its top corners, as tall as its content, about 960px at 1440. Six cut-out objects (raster images with transparent backgrounds, photographed or rendered, 150-375px, each rotated between -18 and +18 degrees) are scattered over the top 650px and stay inside the page margins; one hops toward the pointer on hover. Below them a centred one-line headline at the head step (one style), and 40px under it a filled email field (64px tall, the surface tone, the dealt corner) joined to the dealt button: the page's one email form. A row of four text links at body size and the legal line with an Image credits link close the bottom with 64px padding. No idle sway. Phone: Four objects of 120-200px; the headline on two lines; the field full width.
signature: Six photographed or rendered cut-out objects (150-375px, rotated between -18 and +18 degrees) scattered over the top of a colour-field footer, above a one-line headline and the page's email field.
phone: Four objects of 120-200px; the headline on two lines; the field full width.
avoidWith: a signup or newsletter section elsewhere on the page
houseRuleCheck: Designed out: the id's illustrations (photographed or rendered cut-outs only), the saturated colour (the field colour), the swaying loops (a still page), the white email pill (the surface-tone field with the dealt button), the 14px legal line. Needs real object imagery; if only drawn art exists, do not deal this.

name: Single masked image
description: A footer in flat colour (the dealt field colour: the ink as ground, lettered in the ground colour), as tall as its content, about 680px at 1440, with one picture cropped into a square turned 45 degrees (a diamond about 444px across), centred horizontally and starting 100px from the top. The picture is art-directed or a rendered object, and the field colour is one the picture's palette picks up. 64px under the diamond, one centred row at body size: the legal line with an Image credits link and two contact links, so the page ends clean and still works. On scroll the diamond turns between -5 and 5 degrees and the picture inside shifts 12% in parallax. Phone: Diamond at 70% of the width; the same row.
signature: One photograph cropped into a 444px diamond (a square turned 45 degrees) centred on a flat colour field, turning a few degrees as the footer scrolls, with only a legal line and two links under it.
phone: Diamond at 70% of the width; the same row.
houseRuleCheck: Designed out: the 100vh screen and its empty pause (content height), the 14px row (body size), the saturated colour (the field colour). A diamond crop is a picture mask, not a drawn shape. If the page needs a full sitemap, deal another pattern.

name: Staggered statements and email
description: On the ink ground, as tall as its content, about 700px at 1440, with the page margin as side padding and 96px top padding. The ground is flat: no particles and nothing drawn on it. Two statements form a diagonal reading line: the first left-aligned (x 64-720) at the head step in sentence case; the second 90px lower, right-aligned (ending at the right margin) at the head step, with a text link and arrow at its end. Each statement is two lines at most. 120px lower, at the left, a filled email field (the surface tone, the dealt corner, 48px tall, 420px wide) joined to the dealt button with a body-size hint above it (the page's one email form), and at the right a body-size row with the legal line, an Image credits link and two contact links. Everything is there at once (the dealt entrance). Phone: Statements stack left-aligned at the sub step; the field is full width.
signature: Two head-step statements staggered on a diagonal reading line, the first left-aligned and the second right-aligned to the margin, over a bottom row with a filled email field.
phone: Statements stack left-aligned at the sub step; the field is full width.
avoidWith: a signup or newsletter section elsewhere on the page
houseRuleCheck: Designed out: the drifting particle canvas (particles are a banned decoration), the 44px statements and 1,000px height (head step, content height), the line-by-line reveal (the dealt entrance), the filled accent pill (the dealt button and a text link), the underlined field and dashed credit box.

name: Statement over three word links
description: As tall as its content, about 560px at 1440, on the ink ground, with the page margin as side padding and 96px bottom padding. A two-line statement at the display step in the display face (one style, sentence case) centred in a 720px measure. 80px under it a row of three word links at the head step sharing one baseline: one at the left margin, one centred, one ending at the right margin (the site's other pages, or its sections and the contact on a one-page site; never a dead link). Then a legal row in three thirds at body size (copyright at the left, one link in the centre, an Image credits link at the right). Hover slides the hovered word 8px up and tints it with the accent while the others dim to the muted ink. Phone: Statement at the head step; the three words stacked at the sub step, centred.
signature: A two-line display statement over three head-step word links spread to the left margin, the centre and the right margin on one baseline; hovering one lifts it 8px and dims the other two.
phone: Statement at the head step; the three words stacked at the sub step, centred.
houseRuleCheck: Designed out: the 100px three-line statement and the upper-case option (display step, sentence case, two lines), the 100vh height (content height), the 300ms colour wipe on click, the one-line credit (an Image credits link). The statement is one style with no accent word.

name: Two info cards
description: On the page ground, as tall as its content, about 480px at 1440, with the page margin as side padding. Two equal cards share the content width (648px each, 16px gap, the dealt corner), both filled with the surface tone (never two different fills), 40px padding. In each card a heading at the sub step in the strong weight (for example visit, write), and 48px under it a three-line address or contact block at the lead step in the muted ink (an email gets a Copy text control beside it). Under the two cards a body-size row of the legal links and an Image credits link. No rules or lines. Hover underlines the contact line in ink. Phone: Cards stack, text at body size or larger.
signature: Two equal filled cards (648px wide, 16px apart) headed visit and write, each with a three-line address or contact block, and no link columns.
phone: Cards stack, text at body size or larger.
houseRuleCheck: Designed out: the accent card beside a darker-tint card (both on the surface tone), the id's rules and table (no lines at all), the 14px legal row (body size). The contact lines stay below display size, three lines at most.

name: Wide info column, joined email
description: A directory footer as tall as its content, about 420px at 1440 (never under 360px), on the ink ground, with the page margin as side padding. A wide first column (x 64-700): a three-line text block at the lead step; 24px under it a text link and an Image credits link; at the foot of the column the logo (113px wide) over the copyright at body size. Two narrow link columns at the right (x 740 and 1090; titles at the lead step in the strong weight, body-size links on a 36px step). Under them a joined email field and the dealt button, 587x44 across both columns (the field in the surface tone, the dealt corner): the page's one email form. Hover grows a link underline in from the left. Phone: The text block first, the link columns 2-up, the joined field full width.
signature: A wide three-line info column at the left (text, logo, copyright) against two narrow link columns with one joined email field spanning them.
phone: The text block first, the link columns 2-up, the joined field full width.
avoidWith: a signup or newsletter section elsewhere on the page
houseRuleCheck: Designed out: the 130x100 picture beside the text (a small picture filling a gap), the 24px margins (the page margins), the one-line credit (an Image credits link), the accent-fill submit (the dealt button). Never a wall of sponsor logos.
